source_snapshot.items: Check GPU is suitable for ROCm SMI
source_snapshot.procedure: Build ROCm and DCT/RDC, then check whether DCT can control the AMD GPU.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES follows the SMI title with read-only `rocm-smi` but claims it also proves DCT control.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Identifies ROCm SMI read-only suitability versus DCT write-capable control conflict and overlap with row211.

old_problem: Title/test-set require ROCm SMI suitability, whereas all Procedure and Criteria text require DCT build/control already covered by row211; choosing either branch loses or duplicates material coverage.
disposition_reason: SMI enumeration/telemetry and DCT write-capable control are non-equivalent in purpose, risk and evidence. No ED rule selects title over literal Procedure/Criteria or permits double-counting row211. Project authority must choose or split variants before a correct command/oracle can be established.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row212 all18 XLSX cells and history2816.
Kept the SMI title and DCT Procedure/Criteria as explicit conflicting requirements and identified row211 overlap.
Rejected `rocm-smi` as proof of DCT control and did not invent a write action. No build, control or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: ROCm SMI versus DCT suitability case pending authoritative scope split
test_case.purpose: After scope selection, validate either ROCm SMI read-only management suitability or a separately governed DCT control capability without losing SMI coverage or duplicating row211.
required_package: Authoritative decision: SMI, DCT, or separately identified variants and row211 relationship
For SMI: pinned ROCm/SMI artifact, stable GPU map, required telemetry/field schema and read-only oracle
For DCT: pinned DCT/RDC artifact and approved reversible control property from the row211 contract
Branch-specific privileges, expected results and log acceptance
For any write branch: bounded value, readback, restore, abort and OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute while scope is unresolved. If SMI is authoritative, run the approved read-only ROCm SMI commands for every stable GPU identity and validate all required telemetry/management fields. If DCT is retained as a separate variant, use only the approved reversible control contract and keep its evidence/identity distinct from row211. `rocm-smi` output cannot prove DCT control.
test_case.expected_result: The selected branch's exact capability is proven for every intended GPU with complete branch-specific evidence; no DCT coverage is duplicated and no SMI capability is discarded.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is impossible until scope is approved. SMI requires read-only field completeness/validity; DCT requires bounded write/readback/restore. Evidence from one branch cannot pass the other.
safety_gate: No write-capable DCT action without explicit property/value/recovery approval.
Pin all targets by UUID/BDF and verify artifact/version provenance.
Keep row211 and any row212 DCT variant independently traceable.
Abort on target/schema mismatch, unexpected state change, GPU fault or restore failure; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Pinned branch artifact/version and stable GPU map
SMI full read-only field outputs or DCT before/write/readback/restore evidence
GPU/kernel/BMC health and, for DCT, verified restoration
test_case.recovery: SMI read-only collection requires no state recovery. A DCT branch must restore its recorded baseline immediately and use only the approved OOB/service recovery on failure. Do not switch branches or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: ROCm SMI title/test-set and DCT-only Procedure/Criteria remain materially contradictory and overlap row211.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete; execution is prohibited until scope and branch-specific oracle/recovery are approved.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Choose SMI versus DCT or split variants, define row211 relationship and provide branch-specific artifacts/oracle/recovery.
pending.owner: ROCm SMI/DCT, AMD GPU platform and testcase identity owners.
pending.unlock_condition: Approve a non-duplicative authoritative scope or two independently identified variants with complete branch contracts.

project_authority: Only testcase/project authority may resolve the conflicting coverage and duplication relationship.
